Only then consider a SELL — do not chase if price has already left the zone
Close a portion at TP1 3,550.6, then move the stop to the entry 3,564.2–3,576.8
Leave the rest for TP2 3,535.1 and TP3 3,515.2 — cancel if price goes through 3,585.7
